description:
• About our brand and products:

IONEE is a premium beauty technology brand inspired by the professional microcurrent protocols used in leading Korean beauty institutes. Our flagship device is designed to help improve the appearance of skin firmness, facial definition and overall skin quality through quick daily treatments at home.

• What makes us different:

Unlike many beauty devices that focus only on the skin surface, IONEE uses 6 simultaneous electrodes to provide broader facial muscle coverage and a professional-inspired treatment experience. We combine premium technology, elegant design and high-converting content opportunities.

• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn 25% commission on every qualified sale generated through their affiliate link or coupon code. With our premium positioning and attractive average order value, each referral can generate meaningful commissions.

• How to promote us:

IONEE performs particularly well through TikTok, Instagram Reels, Stories, tutorials, beauty routines, product reviews and authentic lifestyle content. We welcome creators, beauty enthusiasts and content creators whose audience aligns with the IONEE brand and customer profile.

WELCOME TO THE IONEE AFFILIATE PROGRAM

These Terms and Conditions govern participation in the IONEE Affiliate Program. By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

1. Approval of Applications

IONEE reserves the right to approve or decline any affiliate application at its sole discretion.

We may refuse or remove affiliates whose content, promotional methods, or business practices are inconsistent with the IONEE brand or these Terms.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Affiliates may receive a unique referral link and/or coupon code.

Commissions are attributed according to the tracking rules established by the Program. A customer purchase will only generate one commission and duplicate rewards will not be granted.

Affiliates may promote IONEE through websites, blogs, social media platforms, email marketing, or other lawful marketing channels.

Affiliates must not engage in misleading, deceptive, spam, or unethical promotional practices.

3. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn a 30% commission on eligible sales generated through their affiliate link or assigned coupon code.

Commission is calculated on product value only and excludes taxes, shipping fees, discounts, duties, and any other additional charges.

Commissions are reviewed and approved by IONEE before payment.

Approved commissions become payable 30 days after the order date, provided the order has not been refunded, cancelled, disputed, charged back, or identified as fraudulent.

Orders that are refunded, cancelled, disputed, charged back, or otherwise deemed ineligible will not generate commission.

IONEE reserves the right to withhold, cancel, or reverse commissions in cases of suspected fraud, self-referrals, artificial transactions, abuse of the Program, or violation of these Terms.

4. Marketing Materials

IONEE may provide affiliates with logos, images, videos, banners, and other promotional materials.

These materials remain the property of IONEE and may only be used for the purpose of promoting IONEE products.

5. Content Usage

By participating in the Affiliate Program, you grant IONEE permission to repost, share, edit, and use content you voluntarily create featuring IONEE products for marketing and promotional purposes, including social media, website content, email campaigns, and advertisements.

6. Cookies and Tracking

The Program uses cookies and other tracking technologies to attribute sales.

If cookies are blocked, deleted, or unavailable, commissions may not be tracked correctly and therefore may not be payable.

Tracking duration is specified within the Affiliate Dashboard.

7. Termination

IONEE reserves the right to suspend or terminate any affiliate account at any time for violations of these Terms, fraudulent activity, abuse of the Program, or conduct that may harm the IONEE brand.

Affiliates may leave the Program at any time by contacting us.

8. Contact

For any questions regarding the Affiliate Program, please contact:

contact@ioneebeauty.com

Thank you for being part of the IONEE Affiliate Program.
